editPage.readyWhenComplete: The editor is ready once your generation completes.

errors.conflict: A newer draft exists on the server. Your local changes are retained. Download a draft backup, then reload the saved version to resolve the conflict.
errors.combineTimeout: The combine is still running in the export queue. Refresh your clips when it completes.
errors.prepareTimeout: Source preparation is taking longer than expected. Reopen the editor to check its status.
errors.transcriptTooLong: Edit this long transcript one word at a time.
errors.cannotEncode: This browser cannot encode this video. Choose background export to render it on the server.
errors.cannotLoadSource: Could not load the source video.
errors.canvasUnavailable: Canvas is unavailable. Use background export.
errors.cannotDecode: This browser cannot decode the source. Use background export.
errors.audioEncodeUnavailable: Audio encoding is unavailable. Use background export.

captions.styleDescription: Pick a look, then fine-tune it below.
captions.saveFailed: Could not save style on this device
captions.hookDescription: Drag the title’s timeline edges to set when it appears. Leave empty to remove it.
captions.transcriptDescription: Correct a word without moving its timing. Click play to hear it in context.
captions.scriptHint: Existing words keep their timing. Review the timing of inserted words.

framing.title: Framing
framing.description: Drag the video in the preview to keep your subject in focus.
framing.landscapeHint: This clip contains wide detail. A landscape version keeps it readable without cropping content.

audioPanel.title: Audio
audioPanel.description: Audio changes are included in your export.
audioPanel.noTrack: This clip has no audio track.
audioPanel.boostWarning: Boosting quiet audio can clip loud peaks. Listen through before exporting.

effects.title: Effects
effects.description: Effects apply to the video. Captions stay crisp.

preview.fontError: Caption font could not load. Check your connection before exporting.
preview.framingHint: Drag the video to reframe · captions stay in place
preview.captionHint: Drag text to move · drag a corner to resize · click to edit
preview.title: Preview
preview.safeAreaTip: Show where platform UI covers the video

export.queuedAll: Clips added to the export queue
export.title: Ready for the feed
export.description: Export your current edit. Background exports keep running when you leave.
export.opusNote: This browser uses Opus audio in MP4. Background export provides wider player compatibility with AAC audio.

workspace.keepLocal: Your draft is kept locally. Save it before switching clips.
workspace.styleApplied: Caption style applied to all clips
workspace.combined: Combined draft created. Original clips are unchanged.
workspace.storageFull: Local draft storage is full or unavailable. Keep this tab open until the server confirms your changes are saved.
workspace.combineHint: Uses selection order and the first clip’s style. Originals are kept.
workspace.combineOneMore: Select one more clip to combine.
workspace.combineEmpty: Tick two or more clips to combine them into one draft.
workspace.draftNote: Generated clips are never overwritten. Every change here is an editable draft.
workspace.previewBackDetail: Your original clip is safe. Retry preparation to continue.
workspace.preparingDetail: Loading the original video, word timings, thumbnails, and audio waveform. This only happens once per clip.
workspace.shortcutsDescription: Shortcuts work whenever you’re outside a text field.
workspace.restoreDescription: This resets cuts, captions, framing, audio, and effects. You can undo this action.
workspace.reloadDescription: This replaces local changes and undo history with the server draft. Back up your draft first if you want to keep your local changes.

broll.title: B-roll
broll.description: Stock footage shown over the clip while the speaker keeps talking. Captions stay on top.
broll.empty: No B-roll yet. Auto-fill picks moments from what's said, or search below.
broll.replaceDescription: Pick footage to use instead. The timing stays the same.
broll.searchDescription: Search stock videos and pick one to add at the playhead ({time}).
broll.searchPlaceholder: e.g. city at night, coffee pour
broll.addResult: Add footage by {credit} at the playhead
broll.noResults: Nothing found for “{query}”. Try a simpler, more visual search.
broll.noRoom: There's B-roll at the playhead already. Move the playhead to a free spot.
broll.suggested: Added {count, plural, one {# B-roll clip} other {# B-roll clips}}.
broll.nothingSuggested: Nothing new to add: no other moment names something filmable.
broll.unavailable: Stock footage isn't set up on this server, so B-roll can't be added.

ai.label: Ask AI to edit this clip
ai.placeholder: Edit with AI, e.g. remove the filler words
ai.editedMeanwhile: You edited the clip while the AI worked, so its change wasn't applied yet.
ai.timeout: The AI took too long. Try again.
ai.failed: Couldn't reach the AI. Try again.
ai.title: AI edit
